name: TensorPM v1.44.2
body:
# Changelog - v1.44.2

This patch brings security updates for the app runtime and the mail component. There are no
new features and nothing changes in how you work.

## 🔒 Security

- **Up-to-date runtime:** TensorPM now runs on Electron 43.8.3. It no longer trusts certificates
  from a certificate authority whose intermediate certificates were compromised in October 2026,
  and it includes the latest security fixes for the built-in browser engine.
- **Safer mail sending:** the component TensorPM uses to send mail through your own mail server
  (SMTP) is updated to version 10 and closes several known vulnerabilities.

## 🏗️ Improvements

- Updated helper libraries, including the build tooling.

## 📝 Notes

- No action needed. The update installs like any other.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.44.2
- **Release Date**: 2026-10-22
- **Previous Version**: 1.44.1
- **Type**: Patch Release
